user_query: I'm a music lover and I want to explore different genres. Fetch the top songs of different genres on Shazam and suggest some related artists for each genre. Additionally, search for playlists on Soundcloud that represent each genre to broaden my musical horizons.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top songs of various music genres from Shazam.
For each genre, suggest related artists based on the top songs fetched.
Search for playlists on Soundcloud that represent each of the genres explored.
